2608.28009.title: Beyond Global Scalars: Synergizing Token-Level Statistics and Deep Semantics for Adversarial AIGC Text Detection
2608.28009.paper_summary: The rapid evolution of large language models necessitates robust machine-generated text detection. Existing paradigms typically follow two isolated tracks. Training-free methods rely on global statistical scalars such as perplexity, while training-based methods utilize semantic hidden states. Both approaches exhibit fundamental vulnerabilities in adversarial scenarios. Global scalars act as lossy compressions that obscure local probabilistic burstiness in interleaved texts, whereas pure semantic models overfit to specific fingerprints and remain susceptible to spoofing. To expose these flaws, we introduce MOSAIC, a comprehensive adversarial benchmark comprising 16000 samples across a full-granularity attack spectrum. To address these challenges, we propose NeuroStat, an end-to-end framework bridging the statistical and semantic gap. NeuroStat captures uncompressed token-level probabilistic logits alongside deep semantic hidden states from a single causal language model backbone. We fuse these heterogeneous signals through Macro-State Residual Modulation, which adaptively calibrates local convolutional features using global uncertainty indicators. Orthogonal and contrastive losses further ensure the learning of complementary representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NeuroStat maintains exceptional robustness on MOSAIC compared to the severe degradation of state-of-the-art methods, establishing a new standard for adversarial text detection. Code and the MOSAIC benchmark are available at https://github.com/TencentBAC/NeuroStat.
2608.28009.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型的快速演變需要強大的機器生成文本檢測。現有的範式通常遵循兩條孤立的路徑。無需訓練的方法依賴於全局統計標量，例如困惑度，而基於訓練的方法則利用語義隱藏狀態。這兩種方法在對抗場景中都顯示出基本的脆弱性。全局標量作為有損壓縮，掩蓋了交錯文本中的局部概率突發性，而純語義模型則過度擬合特定的指紋，並且容易受到欺騙。為了揭示這些缺陷，我們引入了MOSAIC，一個包含16000個樣本的綜合對抗基準，涵蓋了全範圍的攻擊光譜。為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了NeuroStat，一個端到端的框架，橋接統計和語義之間的差距。NeuroStat捕獲了未壓縮的標記級概率邏輯，同時從單一的因果語言模型主幹中獲取深層語義隱藏狀態。我們通過宏狀態殘差調製融合這些異質信號，該方法根據全局不確定性指標自適應地校準局部卷積特徵。正交和對比損失進一步確保了互補表示的學習。廣泛的實驗表明，與最先進的方法的嚴重降級相比，NeuroStat在MOSAIC上保持了卓越的穩健性，為對抗文本檢測建立了新的標準。代碼和MOSAIC基準可在https://github.com/TencentBAC/NeuroStat上獲得。
